With that high-intensity focus, does your competitive fire burn brightest when you are relying solely on your own execution, or when you are navigating the complexities of a team unit?

Team synergy: I thrive on tactical coordination and the shared energy of a squad.

As you consider your high-performance pathway, how do you tend to respond to the pressure of competition when the clock is ticking and the intensity is at its peak?
